Question: Which topic is most likely to be associated with a pro-immigration stance?
Evidence:
[E1] (figure, Figure 2, page 8) (image attached): Figure 2: Topics inferred by a joint model of words and tone, and the corresponding probability of pro- immigration tone for each topic. A topic is repre- sented by the top words sorted by word probability throughout the paper.
Words printed in the figure: 0 1 p(pro-immigration | topic) arrested charged charges agents operation state gov benefits arizona law bill bills bush border president bill republicans labor jobs workers percent study wages asylum judge appeals deportation court visas visa applications students citizenship boat desert died men miles coast haitian english language city spanish community
[E2] (figure, Figure 2, page 8): a zoomed view of Figure 2 (image attached) [image]

claims.text: Figure 2 shows the probability of pro-immigration tone for each topic.

cites.quote: Figure 2: Topics inferred by a joint model of words and tone, and the corresponding probability of pro- immigration tone for each topic.

claims.text: Based on the plot showing p(pro-immigration | topic), the topic associated with the highest probability is represented by the words english language city spanish community.

cites.observation: In the plot, the topmost dot corresponding to the highest value on the horizontal axis is aligned with the topic words english language city spanish community.
